question.text: `Roshni Trust`, a Section 12AB-registered NPO running special education for the visually impaired and listed on NSE-SSE, must undertake an annual independent Social Impact Assessment. Under which SEBI (ICDR) regulation is this mandated?

answer.text: Reg 292I — Impact Assessment / Social Impact Assessment

explanation.text: The Logic: Reg 292I mandates each SE listed on SSE (whether the instrument is ZCZP, equity, DIB, or SVF unit) to undertake annual Social Impact Assessment, conducted by an independent SIA empanelled with ICAI under Reg 292K. The output feeds the Annual Impact Report under Reg 292L. The Trap: Reg 292F governs rights of ZCZP holders (no-voting, return of corpus to SE objects). Reg 292G is corporate governance (board, committees). Reg 292J covers SRO oversight of SIAs (not the SE's own assessment mandate). Cross-Exam Context: III-A / III-C (Compliance) covers disclosure rules; XXIII tests the specific 292I / 292L axis which is the SIA's direct work-product mandate. Memorise I (impact) → K (empanelment) → L (report). Assessor's Pro-Tip: Your engagement letter should cite Reg 292I expressly as the source of the SE's obligation and Reg 292K as the source of your authority to perform it. That pairing makes the independence position unambiguous to regulators and auditors of the SE.
